chunks: Only they are true believers whose hearts fill up with awe when the name of God is mentioned; and their faith is further strengthened when His messages are read out to them; and those who place their trust in their Lord,
ai.seo_question: What are the defining characteristics of true believers according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse, the first of Surah Al-Anfal, establishes the foundational traits of true believers (al-mu'minun) in Shia exegesis, emphasizing that genuine faith is characterized by khushu' (spiritual humility) and active reliance on God (tawakkul). It serves as a theological benchmark distinguishing sincere conviction from mere nominal belief, linking internal spiritual states with external divine guidance.
